last_message:
Scorer ran cleanly. Results:

| Split | TP | FP | FN | Precision | Recall | F1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| dev | 45 | 268 | 25 | 0.144 | 0.643 | 0.235 |
| holdout | 25 | 128 | 10 | 0.163 | 0.714 | **0.266** |

Recall is strong (71% of true anomalies found) but precision is low (many false positives). That's exactly what you'd expect from a fresh baseline — the threshold and merge parameters haven't been tuned yet. The engine neither crashes nor cheats; it generalises correctly to the holdout split.
